title: Theoretical Study for Generating Optical GKP State via a Single-Photon-Added Squeezed Vacuum
summary: A theoretical framework is developed to analyze the generation of the optical GKP state using a single-photon-added squeezed vacuum. This state, defined by the squeezing parameter $r$, is injected into a 50:50 beam splitter, and the optical GKP state is obtained through conditional measurement at one output port.
